item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Vikram must construct an exact $15^{\circ}$ angle at point $A$ on ray $AX$ in the diagram, using equal-radius arcs and angle bisection.

Which plan is correct?

options.A: Build a $60^{\circ}$ angle at $A$ with equal-radius arcs that form an equilateral triangle, bisect to $30^{\circ}$, then bisect again to obtain $15^{\circ}$.
options.B: Name ray $AX$ as the finished $15^{\circ}$ angle, and stop before drawing any arcs.
options.C: The repeated bisections come from first marking $15^{\circ}$ on ray $AX$.
options.D: Construct a $45^{\circ}$ angle at $A$ and treat it as $15^{\circ}$.
